title: Zetta-Joule (Hearthgrid)
description: A calm engineering look: white and pale-blue pages with navy copy, a warm-grey and near-black instrument dark for the chart, carousel and footer bands, and one pale sky-blue accent. Featherlight Geist (weight 250) for headings and Inter for text, 4px corners everywhere, no shadows.
notes: light is the faithful mode; dark bands inside the page add the `dark` class to themselves, and `.dark` is the sibling mode
glow is the sky blue #628ad1 (hero sky, chart bars); chart-5 is the peach end of the hero gradient
highlight is navy in light mode: copy on the pale-blue panels; primary is the pale-blue CTA with black text
popover in the dark scope is pure black (footer, callout card)
